Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around an instance of a binary search specification, with the integer width fixed to 8 bits. It leaves the input sequence and input key unconstrained except for initializing them with arbitrary generated values of the proper bounded integer types via ConstInit, so the intent is to reason about all such inputs rather than one concrete example. The file itself introduces the binary-search state variables, instantiates BinSearch8, and defines only a constant-initialization predicate; it does not define the transition relation, temporal specification, or correctness properties locally in this module.
